units.source_text: 应该和女人打个招呼再走吧？

en.t: Should he say a word of goodbye to the woman before leaving?

units.source_text: 可是把女人叫醒，反而会让她觉得羞耻。

en.t: But waking the woman would only make her feel ashamed.
Then what should he do about the lodging fee?

units.source_text: ……回家路上，顺便去渔业联合组织的办公室，把钱交给昨天介绍自己来这里的老头，他能代为传递一下就行了嘛。

en.t: ... On the way home, he could stop by the fisheries cooperative office and give the money to the old man who had introduced him here yesterday; it would be enough if the old man passed it on for him.
